notes:
Quick summary: small SaaS (helpdesk-centric) building a lightweight automation layer on top of Zendesk/Front. Came in via inbound blog post on ticket summarization. Curious about Redwood hosted API — wants self-serve onboarding, predictable per-ticket cost, and streaming for agent UI.

Recent activities / timeline:
- 2026-02-12: Inbound signup on blog guide 'Summarize tickets with LLMs' — captured lead via form (auto-qualified).
- 2026-02-15: Initial discovery call (Ava M.) — product/tech founder + lead engineer present. Covered high-level flows and clearly called out: structured JSON output for downstream automation, tool-calling (create/update ticket API), and short abstractive summaries for agents.
- 2026-02-19: Deeper technical sync with SE (Riley C.) — shared sample dataset (2000 tickets, redacted) and zapier-style actions they want to trigger. Fireflies: ff_20260219_01_call.
- 2026-02-23: Asked for cost estimate for 3k tickets/day; we provided back-of-envelope costing and suggested batching + prefix caching to reduce token spend.
- 2026-03-01: Follow-up email — they request sandbox keys and concrete examples for structured output (JSON schema + function call examples).

Use-case & requirements (from call notes):
- Primary workload: ticket_summarization + structured output to populate ticket fields (priority, category, SLA, root_cause_hint).
- Secondary: tool_calling to trigger automations (add_note, escalate, assign) via Redwood function/tool calling integration.
- Latency target: 300–700ms p95 for agent-facing single-ticket summaries; background batch summarization can tolerate 3–6s per ticket.
- Throughput: ~100–150 requests/minute peak (during US daytime); expect 3k–5k tickets/day.
- Cost sensitivity: high; early-stage, budget-constrained. Interested in batching and quantization recommendations.
- Model preferences: open to smaller open models that are cost-effective; quality beats raw cheapest, but want guidance.
- Routing/fallback: want automated fallback to cheaper model variant if latency spikes or quota reached.
- Security: need SSO (SAML) for internal console, SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logs for tool calls; no hard requirement for data residency yet but asked about retention controls.

Quotes / paraphrases: "We want reliable summaries that plug into our automation rules — if the JSON is wrong, everything breaks." 

Next steps (short):
- Provide sandbox API key + example function-calling payloads and JSON schemas (action mapping).
- Share recommended batching template and a sample billing estimate for 3k/day vs 10k/day.
- Schedule 30m POC kickoff with devs (week of 2026-03-08).

Open questions / blockers:
- How long are logs/inputs retained by hosted API? Need retention policy for ticket content and option to disable retention.
- Can we get a demo of streaming integration into their agent UI (React)? SE to prepare small sample app.
- Budget expected to be approved in Q2 — will require a compact pilot under $5k/mo.

CRM notes tone: short, bullety, technical. Favor self-serve flow; likely close to hosted_api if POC goes well. High chance (40–60%) to convert to a small monthly paying account; upsell potential to Optimize recommendations once volume grows.
